images.filename: Cornwall Beach - geograph.org.uk - 1700975.jpg
images.caption: Cornwall Beach Two swans make use of the beach, which is approached down an imposing flight of semi-circular stone steps, but which is unlikely to attract many sun-worshippers. Beyond is 1699291. It's hard to ignore the heavily secured roadway that runs above, connecting different parts of the naval dockyard.
